title: US-14 DFD: record and read viewed history

flows.label: Opened owned recipe id and verified principal
Upserted owned view with server lastViewedAt
Complete recipe details or sanitized error
Owned recipe records for history entries

rules: All protected input is authenticated and owner-scoped under process 8.0 (US-15). Every referenced object ID, including recipeId in a request body, is checked against the verified account before a read/write. Client owner IDs are rejected or ignored.
Only a successful detail-open event produces view data. Generation or favoriting alone sends no history write.
Use one account/recipe view record; reopening refreshes lastViewedAt, not an additional record. Order by most recent view; recipe-id tie breaking is an explicitly proposed deterministic detail.
No inventory write occurs: recipe, shopping, favorite and history actions never deduct or restock fridge ingredients.
